status: post-transfer development; not an independent confirmation

information_boundary.risk_gate_evidence: available selected-centre count at the current update only

information_boundary.rejected_update_behavior: do not update the belief and return the physical-prior trajectory exactly throughout that interval

claim_boundary: This replay may quantify the post-hoc support-gate mechanism but cannot confirm v2. A separately locked, outcome-unseen cohort is required for any paper claim.
